paragraphs: The Korean War Wagon brings a heavy wooden body and armored protection to the role of a mounted archer. Its covered fighting compartment gives this distinctive vehicle the appearance of a small moving fortress.
In Age of Empires, a line of these wagons can keep firing through attacks that would overwhelm lighter archers.
The Elite War Wagon relies on endurance and ranged firepower. Its armor makes it especially tough against arrows, while the Elite upgrade strengthens an already durable unit.
That protection comes with limited mobility. Spearmen, skirmishers and camel riders can exploit its weaknesses, making the distance between the armies an important part of every battle.
